preconditions.description: The size of the grid n must be between 2 and 100.
Alice's chosen color a must be one of the three colors 1, 2, or 3.
Bob's chosen color b must be one of the three colors 1, 2, or 3, and different from Alice's choice a.
The coordinates (i, j) must be within the bounds of the grid.

postconditions.description: Bob must output the chosen color b and coordinates (i, j) for each turn.

postconditions.expression: not any((grid[i][j] == grid[x][y] for x, y in [(i-1, j), (i+1, j), (i, j-1), (i, j+1)] if 1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n))
postconditions.description: Bob's move must not create a conflict by placing a token of the same color in an adjacent cell.
The grid must be fully filled after n^2 turns.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"2 <= n <= 100","description":"The size of the grid n must be between 2 and 100."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= a <= 3","description":"Alice's chosen color a must be one of the three colors 1, 2, or 3."},{"id":"P3","expression":"1 <= b <= 3 and b != a","description":"Bob's chosen color b must be one of the three colors 1, 2, or 3, and different from Alice's choice a."},{"id":"P4","expression":"1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n","description":"The coordinates (i, j) must be within the bounds of the grid."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == f'{b} {i} {j}'","description":"Bob must output the chosen color b and coordinates (i, j) for each turn."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"not any((grid[i][j] == grid[x][y] for x, y in [(i-1, j), (i+1, j), (i, j-1), (i, j+1)] if 1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n))","description":"Bob's move must not create a conflict by placing a token of the same color in an adjacent cell."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"len(grid) == n and len(grid[0]) == n","description":"The grid must be fully filled after n^2 turns."}],"invariants":[]}
